mappedTags.description:de: Im Zentrum der letzten Stadt Angkors und vielleicht ein Mikrokosmos des Königreichs mit Darstellungen aller wichtigen Gottheiten - buddhistische zum Süden und Osten, hinduistische zum Norden und Westen.
mappedTags.description:en: At the centre of the last city of Angkor and perhaps a microcosm of the kingdom with representations of all the major divinities - Buddhist to the south and east, and Hindu to the north and west.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Bayon exterior: actual outer gallery compound and inner cruciform platform, a43m central stepped sanctuary, seven other mapped principal tower parts, two separately mapped eastern libraries and29 picture/layout-guided secondary tower estimates. Four-sided shallow stone face reliefs carry the identity near the camera. Open colonnades, surviving lintels, interrupted gallery roofs, cardinal approaches and terraces remain distinct. Independent nearby buildings are preserved.

pictures.author: Diego Delso
pictures.observations: Wide low stepped sandstone platform, largely open colonnaded galleries with surviving lintels, staggered face towers and a taller central stepped sanctuary tower. Grey and warm brown stone; missing roof stretches and rubble remain visible. The ordinary article describes a43m central tower and37 surviving towers; exact tower/face inventories are not surveyed.

pictures.author: Sasha India
pictures.observations: Faces are shallow rounded stone reliefs integrated into tower sides: broad noses, downcast almond eyelids, gently smiling broad lips, full cheeks and elongated side ears. Tower tops are irregular stepped lotus-like courses; some ends are truncated. Fine cracks, carvings, lichen and precise stone inventories are omitted from medium-fi geometry.

pictures.author: Tomas Bilbao Plasencia
pictures.observations: Modern explanatory plan shows an inner tower cluster, corner/cardinal outer gopuras and two libraries on either side of the eastern entrance. Its caption explicitly says upper-terrace dimensions are approximate. It guides the approximate secondary arrangement only; it is not a surveyed present tower or roof inventory. The ordinary article identifies the two courtyard libraries.
